players.bio: Adama Boiro Boiro is a professional footballer who plays as a left-back for EFL Championship club West Ham United, on loan from La Liga club Athletic Bilbao.

Airidas Golambeckis is an 18-year-old English professional footballer who plays as a centre-back or defensive midfielder for West Ham United. Known for his intelligence, composure on the ball, and versatility, he is highly regarded as one of the most promising talents in the West Ham United Academy.

Alphonse Francis Areola (born 27 February 1993) is a French professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL Championship club West Ham United. An academy graduate of PSG, he spent the early parts of his career on loan, enjoying spells with Lens, Bastia and Villarreal.
Arne Engels is a Belgian professional footballer who plays as a midfielder or right winger for EFL Championship club West Ham United and the Belgium national team.

Bruno Saltor Grau (Spanish pronunciation: ; born 1 October 1980), known simply as Bruno, is a Spanish football coach and former player who played as a right-back. He is currently assistant head coach of Premier League club West Ham United. He began his professional career with Espanyol, and went on to appear in 128 La Liga matches, all but one of which were with Almería and Valencia.
At the end of the 2016/2017 season he retired from playing and became the goalkeeping coach with the Brighton & Hove Albion club's youth teams.

Divine Tayon Mahogany Mukasa (born 22 August 2007) is an English professional footballer who plays as a forward or attacking midfielder for EFL Championship club West Ham United, on loan from Premier League club Manchester City.

Edson Omar Álvarez Velázquez (born 24 October 1997) is a Mexican professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder or centre-back for EFL Championship club West Ham United, and captains the Mexico national team.
Edvin Austbø is a Norwegian professional footballer who plays as a left winger or left midfielder for EFL Championship club West Ham United.
El Hadji Malick Diouf (born 28 December 2004) is a Senegalese professional footballer who plays as a left-back or left wing-back for Premier Lеague club Brentford and the Senegal national team.
Ezra Samuel Korbinian Mayers (born 16 January 2007) is an English professional footballer who plays as a defender for EFL Championship club West Ham United.
Finlay Jacob Herrick (born 18 January 2006) is an English professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL Championship club West Ham United.

George Robert Earthy (born 5 September 2004) is an English professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder or right midfielder for EFL League One club Reading. Club career Earthy joined West Ham United at under-6 level, later signing his first professional contract with the club at the age of 17 in June 2022.

James Michael Edward Ward-Prowse is an English professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder for EFL Championship club Southampton. Originally a member of Southampton's youth system, Ward-Prowse made his first-team debut for the club in October 2011, and signed his first professional contract in May 2012. He has gone on to become a regular for the club, making over 100 appearances.

Jarrod Bowen (born 20 December 1996) is an English professional footballer who plays as a winger, midfielder and forward for EFL Championship club West Ham United.. He has previously played for Hereford United and Hull City.

Joël Mohammed Ramzan Piroe (born 2 August 1999) is a professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL Championship club West Ham United, on loan from Premier League club Leeds United. Born in the Netherlands, he plays for the Suriname national team.

Joël Ivo Veltman (born 15 January 1992) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a right-back or centre-back for EFL Championship club West Ham United. A product of the Ajax youth academy, Veltman made 246 appearances for the Amsterdam club before moving on to Brighton in July 2020 for a £900,000 fee on a three-year deal.
Josh Landers is a Scottish professional footballer who plays for as a forward for Ayr United, on loan from West Ham United.

Joshua Ajala is a 19-year-old English professional football player who plays as a forward/center-forward for West Ham United F.C.. Regarded as one of the brightest prospects in the club's "Academy of Football," he signed a long-term contract extension in March 2026 that keeps him at East London until the summer of 2028.

Kaelan Michael Casey is an English professional footballer who plays as a center-back for EFL League One club Stevenage F.C., on loan from Premier League side West Ham United F.C.. Career Growing up in Thurrock, Casey joined West Ham's football academy when he was five years-old. In the 2020-21 season, Casey made his debut appearances for the under-18s and played for West Ham in the EFL Trophy.

Keiber Alberto Lamadrid Briceño is a 22-year-old professional Venezuelan footballer who plays as a left winger or left midfielder for EFL Championship club West Ham United and the Venezuela national football team.

Konstantinos Mavropanos (born 11 December 1997) is a Greek professional footballer who plays as a defender for EFL Championship club West Ham United. and the Greece national team. Mainly played as a centre-back, he can also play as a right-back.
Kyle Leonardus Walker-Peters (born 13 April 1997) is an English professional footballer who plays as a full back for EFL Championship club West Ham United.
Lewis William Orford (born 18 February 2006) is an English footballer who plays as a midfielder for West Ham United. He is an England youth international.

Mads Hermansen is a Danish professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL Championship club West Ham United. Hermansen began his youth career at Næsby Boldklub, and transitioned into the goalkeeping role at age 10 where he suffered from achilles tendinitis. In September 2015, Hermansen moved to Brøndby IF. He was promoted to the first team prior to the 2019–20 season.
Manor Solomon (born 24 July 1999) is an Israeli professional footballer who plays as a winger for EFL Championship club West Ham United and the Israel national team.

Maximilian William Kilman (born 23 May 1997) is an English footballer who plays for West Ham United as a defender. On 6 July 2024, Kilman joined West Ham United by signing a seven-year contract, for a reported £40m transfer fee.

Maxwel Cornet (born 27 September 1996) is an Ivorian professional footballer who plays as a left winger and full-back for EFL Championship club West Ham He has previously played in France for Metz II, Metz, Lyon II and Lyon and in England with Burnley.
Mohamadou Kanté (born 20 September 2005) is a French professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL Championship club West Ham United.

Felipe Rodrigues da Silva, commonly known as Morato, is a Brazilian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back or left-back for Championship club West Ham United, on loan from Nottingham Forest. Club career Born in Francisco Morato in the state of São Paulo, Morato was 18 when he moved from the youth ranks of São Paulo to Benfica in September 2019, on a contract lasting until 2024.

Narcís Pèlach Nadal (born 5 September 1988), sometimes known as Chicho, is a Spanish football coach and former player who is a first-team coach at West Ham United. Playing career Pèlach was born in Girona, Catalonia, and joined the youth categories of hometown club Girona at the age of five. He left the side in August 2007, and signed for Tercera División newcomers Cassà.

Oliver James Scarles (born 12 December 2005) is an English professional footballer who plays as a left-back for EFL Championship club West Ham United. Club career From Bromley, South East London, Scarles attended the Trinity School in Croydon. Scarles was with West Ham at under-8 level and rejoined after playing with Chelsea from under 9 to under-12s before Chelsea released him.

Pablo Felipe Pereira de Jesus (born 2 January 2004), known simply as Pablo, is a professional footballer who plays as a striker for EFL Championship club West Ham United. Career Famalicão Born in Braga to former FC Porto and S.C. Braga Brazilian player Pena, Pablo joined F.C. Famalicão's youth system at the age of 15, following an unsuccessful trial in his father's homeland with Fluminense FC.

Scott Matthew Parker (born 13 October 1980) is an English professional football manager and former player was most recently the head coach of Burnley. Parker began his career at Charlton Athletic, and was loaned to Norwich City, before joining Chelsea for a £10 million fee in January 2004.

Soungoutou Magassa is a French professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder and centre-back for EFL Championship club West Ham United. Early life Soungoutou Magassa was born in Stains, Seine-Saint-Denis, playing football for several Francilian clubs before joining the Monaco academy in 2018.

Valentín Mariano José Castellanos Giménez (born 3 October 1998), known as Taty Castellanos, is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a striker for EFL Championship club West Ham United. and the Argentina national team.

Tomáš Souček (Czech pronunciation: ; born 27 February 1995) is a Czech professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for EFL Championship club West Ham United. and captains the Czech Republic national team. After representing the Czech Republic in several youth categories, Souček made his debut for the senior side on 15 November 2016 in a friendly match against Denmark.
